We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to join our dynamic EMEA Accounting team in London. This position will be focused on supporting the launches of some of Amazon’s newest global business initiatives and the automation of underlying processes. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, complex environment. The position will require partnering with operational accounting, tax and business finance teams in developing strategic solutions to support our high growth rate through launch methodology design and training, leveraging existing and novel accounting tools used to support new launches and influencing design inputs to longer-term platform development.
Key job responsibilities
Lead accounting project support for new product designs and financial system setups, ensuring appropriate business support and controllership.
Deliver complex cross-functional projects, identifying and communicating risks to senior leadership with clear resolution recommendations.
Execute large-scale process improvements for new business launches and existing processes, defining scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
Develop and transition new processes for month-end activities, including general ledger close, account reconciliations, and financial reporting preparation.
Establish and maintain strong communication channels with global accounting teams.
Monitor and ensure quality of automated accounting entries, financial reporting processes, and controls.
Work in a fast-paced environment, managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting multiple simultaneous project launches.
Apply finance/accounting expertise to identify and incorporate necessary financial reporting elements into new business launches.
Demonstrate solid understanding of computing system interactions and implement internal control elements to support new business activities.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance)
Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
Experience in multiple finance and accounting roles
Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses
Experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
Experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
Experience as a manager with a track record of success
Experience recognizing a challenge and working with a variety of teams and data sources to diagnose the problem and recommend solutions
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Track record of having earned the trust of a leadership team by challenging norms, upgrading team performance, enabling growth, and improving efficiency.

Amazon's automotive business is looking for a Senior Program Manager within the Support Operations and Programs (SOAP) team to serve as the single-threaded owner for a regional market. This role sits at the intersection of Operations Program Management, Process Improvement, and International Operations, requiring someone who can drive operational excellence across a regional market while continuously raising the bar.
You will own end-to-end operations for your assigned market: implementing SOAP policies and processes, monitoring performance, diagnosing systemic issues through root cause analysis, and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. You will serve as the SOAP connective tissue between regional and central teams, as well as external partners (dealers, third-party services, regulatory bodies), ensuring the customer experience meets Amazon's high bar.
You will evaluate what works across markets, what needs adaptation, and what must be purpose-built for the local regulatory and consumer landscape. You will also contribute to international expansion efforts, building repeatable frameworks and mechanisms that scale beyond a single geography. The ideal candidate is a systems-level thinker who leads with data, thrives in ambiguity, and has a track record of delivering cross-functional programs at scale.
Key job responsibilities
Operations Program Management
Implement, localize, and enforce operational policies and standard operating procedures for the international markets, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Policy teams to ensure alignment with regional regulations.
Build and maintain telemetry that provides leadership clear visibility into regional performance. Track progress against goals, surface risks and opportunities early, and ensure data is accurate and actionable.
Monitor key performance indicators across the customer journey (pre-purchase, purchase, post-purchase, dealer operations) and take ownership of closing gaps when performance deviates from targets.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Service, Dealer Operations, Finance) to resolve dependencies, remove blockers, and keep teams moving together on shared priorities.
Process Improvement & Root Cause Analysis
Analyze customer contact, escalation, and concession patterns, customer effort signals, and resolution data to identify cross-cutting failure modes and improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement through root cause analysis on systemic issues, partnering with regional and central teams to design and implement durable corrective actions rather than one-off fixes.
Define and own a measurement framework that connects operational quality to customer outcomes; use metrics to prioritize investments and quantify impact.
Leverage technology and automation (including AI-driven tooling) to increase operational efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and enable high-velocity decision making.
Launch & International Expansion
Support region launches by defining business requirements, success criteria, and rollback triggers in partnership with SOAP, Product, Engineering, and regional stakeholders.
Assess operational readiness to ensure SOAP is prepared for launch and sustained operations.
Build repeatable launch frameworks, playbooks, and mechanisms that can scale to other regions.
Communicate operational changes and launch milestones to senior leadership through clear, actionable narratives and structured program updates.
A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational dashboards to review order volumes, contact rates, and triaging overnight escalations. By mid-morning, you're leading a working session with product and engineering to turn an operational gap into a requirements doc. After lunch, you sync with a dealer partner on process questions ahead of a regional rollout. In the afternoon, you facilitate a cross-functional meeting with Customer Service, Legal, and Payments to unblock a financing workflow. You close the day drafting the weekly operations narrative for the business review.
About the team
The Support Operations and Programs (SOAP) team ensures every customer touchpoint across Amazon's automotive business runs smoothly. We own support operations, operational policy, process design, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement, partnering cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams to deliver a reliable, high-quality customer experience at scale.

Job Title
Senior Business Analyst
About your role:
You will play a crucial role in leading requirements discussions with clients and finalizing business needs from merchant acquiring banks or financial institutions. This role, based in our Milan office, is vital in ensuring successful delivery of comprehensive solution documents and facilitating strong relationships with internal stakeholders and third parties.
The Business Analyst, Merchant Solutions, is responsible for working closely with clients, product teams, technology teams, and third-party partners to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for merchant acquiring and payment solutions. The role serves as a bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring client requirements are translated into scalable, efficient, and compliant payment solutions.
This position requires strong expertise in merchant acquiring, payment processing, card schemes, payment gateways, switching, settlement, reconciliation, and related value-added services
What You’ll Do:
Draft end-to-end merchant acquiring solutions for banks or financial institutions.
Gather requirements, identify appropriate solutions, and ensure successful implementation of merchant solutions
Identify, analyze, research, and resolve functional queries from internal teams and third parties
Ensure the prompt resolution of moderate to complex queries from internal teams and external partners
Interact and communicate effectively with various internal departments
Utilize knowledge of acquiring solutions, platforms, systems, and technical expertise
Act as a consultant, understanding system parameters and options
Identify systemic and business-impacting trends and escalate through proper leadership channels
Experience you’ll need to have:
Extensive SME Functional knowledge in Merchant Acquiring Solutions covering payment gateway, authorization switches, scheme clearing & settlements, merchant pricing, interchange and scheme fees, financial reconciliations
Fluent in Italian & English
Prior experience working within the payments industry
Salary starting at €60,300 - negotiable depending on experience

Job Title
Operational Business Analyst
About your role:
Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Operational Readiness Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by assessing, documenting and coordinating the operational readiness activities required to enable a successful transition into go-live, warranty and business-as-usual.
Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third-party partners, the Operational Readiness Business Analyst helps ensure that operational processes, support models, controls, procedures, training needs and handover requirements are clearly understood, documented and aligned to the target-state solution and implementation plan.
The Operational Readiness Business Analyst is responsible for supporting readiness activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial impact assessment and readiness planning through implementation support, go-live preparation and transition to BAU. The role acts as a key link between business stakeholders, operations, service and support teams, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that operational teams are prepared for change and able to support the target operating model effectively.
Within this context, the role requires a good understanding of issuing and card-processing environments, operational processes and the practical impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.
What you will do:
Supporting the definition and coordination of the operational readiness approach in alignment with project and implementation objectives.
Assessing current-state and target-state operational processes to identify readiness impacts, gaps, dependencies and required changes.
Gathering, analysing and documenting operational readiness requirements across business, service, operations and support teams.
Supporting the identification of impacts to operating procedures, service models, controls, escalation paths, support processes and business continuity arrangements.
Producing and maintaining readiness documentation, including impact assessments, readiness trackers, process documentation, handover requirements and supporting artefacts.
Working closely with implementation, business analysis, product, technology, testing and operations teams to ensure that readiness activities are aligned to the broader programme plan.
Supporting the definition and tracking of readiness criteria for key milestones, go-live and transition to BAU.
Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure that process changes, support requirements, operational dependencies and handover activities are clearly understood and planned.
Supporting training needs assessment and readiness-related communications for impacted teams where required.
Identifying, analysing and resolving operational readiness queries raised by stakeholders, internal teams and third-party partners.
Supporting go-live preparation by ensuring that operational teams, processes and support arrangements are ready for transition.
Acting as a liaison between business, operations, service/support teams and project delivery teams throughout the readiness lifecycle.
Execution & Controls
Managing and maintaining operational readiness deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.
Supporting the planning, prioritisation and tracking of operational readiness activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.
Ensuring that readiness requirements, dependencies, actions and open points are captured, tracked and progressed to closure.
Maintaining operational readiness trackers and supporting the assessment of readiness status across impacted teams and functions.
Working with stakeholders to validate readiness criteria, handover requirements and support arrangements prior to go-live.
Participating in governance meetings, working sessions and status reviews to provide updates on readiness progress, key issues, risks and unresolved dependencies.
Escalating readiness risks, gaps, blockers or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
Supporting implementation and testing activities where operational readiness input is required, including business process validation and handover readiness.
Supporting warranty and BAU transition planning by ensuring that support teams, processes, documentation and responsibilities are clearly defined and agreed.
Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on operational impacts, readiness actions and transition requirements.
Closeout & Transition
Confirming that operational readiness requirements and agreed handover activities have been completed and transitioned appropriately into go-live, warranty and BAU support processes.
Supporting the completion and archiving of readiness documentation, including process updates, handover artefacts and supporting records.
Assisting with post-implementation reviews to assess readiness outcomes, operational issues and improvement opportunities.
Ensuring that outstanding readiness actions, process gaps or follow-up items are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.
Contributing to Lessons Learned activities where applicable.
Experience you’ll need to have:
Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in one or more of the following areas: Operational Readiness, Service Readiness, Business Process Change, Operations, Customer Servicing, Testing, Training, and BAU Handover within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.
Good understanding of implementation lifecycles, go-live readiness, handover processes and transition to BAU.
Working knowledge of issuing, card-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how operational requirements translate into service and support.
Experience that would be great to have:
Business Analysis, Change Management or Project Delivery certification preferred.
Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.
Experience working on multi-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.
Exposure to operational change, support model design or business readiness activities within issuing or payments environments preferred.
Salary starting at €52,470 - negotiable depending on experience

Job Title
Business Analyst
About your role:
Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by gathering, analysing and documenting business and functional requirements in line with programme objectives and delivery needs.
Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third-party partners, the Business Analyst plays a key role in ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, translated into structured functional requirements and aligned to solution capabilities, operational processes and target-state outcomes.
The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting analysis activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial requirements definition and current-state assessment through functional documentation, testing support, go-live readiness and transition to BAU. The role acts as a critical link between business stakeholders, subject matter experts, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that solutions are delivered in line with business, operational and technical requirements.
Within this context, the role requires a solid understanding of issuing and card-processing environments, including client servicing, operational processes and the impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.
What you’ll do:
Leading business and functional requirements discussions with clients, internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, validate and document project needs.
Analysing current-state and target-state processes to identify functional gaps, operational impacts, dependencies and areas requiring clarification or design decisions.
Defining and documenting business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories and other supporting analysis artefacts.
Translating business needs into clear, structured and actionable functional requirements for implementation, product, technology and testing teams.
Supporting solution definition activities by working closely with SMEs, implementation teams, product teams and technical teams to assess options and recommend appropriate functional approaches.
Producing and maintaining analysis documentation across the project lifecycle, including requirements packs, functional specifications, gap analysis, decision logs and process documentation.
Developing and maintaining requirements traceability to ensure approved requirements, changes and decisions are tracked and aligned to delivery outcomes.
Supporting the documentation of the overall functional approach, including impacts to client processes, operational models, controls and target-state solution design.
Identifying, analysing, researching and resolving functional queries raised by internal teams, clients and third-party partners.
Supporting impact assessments related to process changes, regulatory and compliance requirements, operational readiness and implementation activities.
Working closely with issuing, card-processing and operational stakeholders to ensure that business priorities, processing requirements and client expectations are clearly understood and reflected in the solution.
Supporting readiness activities by ensuring that requirements, process impacts, decisions and functional dependencies are clearly understood by all relevant stakeholders.
Acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clear communication and alignment at all stages.
Execution & Controls
Managing and maintaining business analysis deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.
Supporting the planning, prioritisation and delivery of business analysis activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.
Ensuring that requirements are reviewed, validated, approved and baselined in line with agreed governance processes.
Tracking requirement changes, open points, assumptions, dependencies and key decisions throughout the lifecycle of the project.
Supporting the creation and maintenance of functional documentation required for implementation, testing, readiness and go-live activities.
Working with implementation, product, technology and testing teams to ensure requirements are fully understood and correctly translated into solution design and delivery outputs.
Supporting testing activities by reviewing test scenarios, validating coverage against requirements and assisting with defect analysis, functional clarifications and issue resolution.
Supporting user acceptance testing, operational readiness assessments and go-live preparation from a functional and business process perspective.
Participating in governance meetings, status reviews, workshops and working sessions to provide updates on analysis progress, requirement status, key decisions and unresolved issues.
Escalating risks, issues, requirement gaps or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on requirements, impacts, decisions and functional changes.
Supporting implementation events and critical project milestones by providing functional expertise and analysis support where required.
Closeout & Transition
Confirming that business and functional requirements have been delivered, validated and transitioned appropriately into implementation, testing, warranty and BAU support processes.
Supporting the completion of final documentation and ensuring that approved requirements, decisions and analysis artefacts are archived appropriately.
Assisting with the review of implementation outcomes, requirement coverage, defects and lessons learned to identify opportunities for improvement.
Ensuring that outstanding functional queries, requirement gaps or follow-up actions are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.
Contributing to post-implementation reviews and Lessons Learned activities where applicable.
Experience you’ll need to have:
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.
Working knowledge of issuing, card-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how business requirements translate into processing and operational outcomes.
Subject Matter Expert / Business Analyst experience in one or more of the following areas strongly preferred: Regulatory, Compliance, Payment Schemes, Card Processing, Customer Correspondence, Fulfillment, Collections, Risk/Fraud, Disputes, Chargebacks, Retrievals, Testing, Consumer Finance, Credit Cards, Loans, Debit Cards and Retail Cards.
Significant proven experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, functional analysis or solution analysis roles, within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred (6-10 years).
Proven experience supporting and/or leading business analysis activities for medium to large client-facing implementations, conversions or migration initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
Experience that would be great to have:
Business Analysis certification or equivalent professional training preferred.
Experience in issuing, card-processing or broader consumer finance environments strongly preferred.
Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.
Experience working on multi-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.
Exposure to regulatory, operational or processing change initiatives within issuing environments preferred.
Salary starting at €52,470 - negotiable depending on experience

Description
Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day.
We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage.
You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the.
This role is highly cross-functional.
Key job responsibilities
Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously.

Webuild è alla ricerca di un SOC & Incident Response Specialist da inserire all’interno del dipartimento di Global Security and Cyber Defence presso le sedi di Milano o Roma .
Sarà responsabile della resilienza operativa del Gruppo. Il suo obiettivo primario è minimizzare l'impatto degli attacchi informatici coordinando il rilevamento, la risposta e il ripristino dei servizi, garantendo al contempo la piena conformità ai tempi di notifica imposti dalla NIS2.
Principali responsabilità:
Gestione delle fasi di identificazione, contenimento, eradicazione e recovery per tutti gli incidenti di sicurezza, compresa interazione con utente finale;
Supervisione dell'operato del SOC esterno, agendo come punto di escalation per incidenti critici;
Guida del team tecnico di risposta (Blue Team) durante attacchi complessi (esRansomware, APT);
Gestione dei canali di comunicazione tecnica con il CSIRT Italia (ACN);
Preparazione e trasmissione della documentazione di notifica e di gestione dell’incidente prevista dalla NIS2 e dalle indicazioni ACN;
Assicurazione del rispetto dei tempi legali di notifica;
Redazione e mantenimento dei piani di risposta, adattandoli agli scenari specifici;
Definizione delle procedure operative standard per minacce ricorrenti (Phishing, Compromissione credenziali, Malware OT);
Organizzazione delle simulazioni di attacco (Tabletop exercises) per testare la prontezza del management e dei team tecnici;
Conduzione col supporto del SOC, di analisi post-incidente per identificare le root cause e implementare miglioramenti strutturali;
Produzione di report tecnici e di alto livello sulla gestione degli incidenti significativi e sui "near miss".
Requisiti Tecnici:
Esperienza di 5 anni in ambito SOC o Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT);
Costituiscono carattere preferenziale certificazioni: GIAC Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA) o EC-Council ECIH;
Conoscenza approfondita di SIEM, EDR/XDR, analisi dei log e tecniche di analisi forense (digital forensics);
Conoscenza NIS2: Familiarità con i criteri di "significatività" degli incidenti definiti dalla normativa europea.
Soft Skills:
Capacità di prendere decisioni rapide in situazioni di stress;
Buone doti di comunicazione tecnica e istituzionale;
Attitudine al problem solving creativo per scenari non convenzionali (mondo cantiere/OT).

Join us as a Client Director to grow your career at the forefront of insurance distribution.
Make your mark in Client and Broker Engagement
Our Client and Broker Engagement (CBE) team manages AIG’s major client relationships across all product lines, as well as driving new business activity. The team serves major clients and broker partners through an elevated, personalised experience – our client-centric framework drives a consistent experience and best practice, while allowing flexibility to meet the client’s needs.
How you will create an impact
Our Client Directors ensure retention of existing business and identify and deliver a constant stream of targeted new business opportunities across the range of AIG products, by developing and maintaining relationships within a designated portfolio of major companies and by securing strong relationships with key business influencers within the major brokers.
Responsibilities:
Ensure retention of all existing "profitable" business within assigned portfolio in line with product renewal strategies;
Develop and maintain an understanding and working relationship with each company within the assigned portfolio in accordance with the client management process;
Facilitate AIG Corporate relationships at all levels with clients and development clients;
Acquisition of new business from development clients and prospects in accordance with the client management process.
Identify and maintain regular contact with key business influencers at major brokers on assigned portfolio and beyond;
Provide focal point for clients, development clients and prospects within the AIG organisation.
Understand clients and development clients corporate and insurance strategies enabling the Client Director to complete and maintain an account profile; establish an account strategy and ensure the account plan is agreed and executed; be known to both the Client and Client Service Team within Broker;
Identify new and cross sell business opportunities from designated portfolio of clients and development clients and co-ordinate sales process in accordance with the client management process;
Qualify prospects and convert them to clients and development clients in accordance with the client management process
Provide framework and guidance for effective service delivery on assigned portfolio through the client management process;
Maintain a working knowledge of all products and be aware of AIG appetite across the board;
What you’ll need to succeed
Extensive track record of managing major corporate client relationships as a broker, carrier or risk manager.
Experience of corporate insurance programmes both UK and multinational, particularly across main General Insurance products (P&C, Financial Lines, Specialty)
Strong written and verbal communication skills and proven interpersonal skills
Solid profile and reputation in the London commercial insurance market
Strong commercial background
Sales and business development experience
ACII preferable
Excellent IT skills
Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.

Make your mark in Claims

The scope of the fraud role supports AIG to reduce the potential economic loss to the business through the identification and investigation of suspicious insurance claims or suspicious insurance related activities covering all lines of business.
The scope of the recovery role supports AIG’s strategy of maximizing recovery opportunity whilst minimizing recovery expenses, ensuring that there is consistency with the way recovery activity is enabled, tracked, monitored and reported.
Critical to the success of this position is the ability to engage, lead and inspire a team of fraud, recovery and salvage professionals to continue to deliver high quality results while creating the fraud and recovery capability of the future. Create and implement strategies to maximise recovery value and mitigate fraud risk aligned to the Global Fraud and Recovery Key Performance Indicators.
Proven ability to build strong networks with claims, underwriting and external stakeholders and have a proven track record of delivering outstanding results.

Support and engage in identified data, digital and Gen AI strategies through targeted engagement and knowledge sharing to ensure fraud and recovery capabilities have been incorporated.
Proactively drive an effective communication and engagement process with key stakeholders regarding the fraud and recovery value proposition, results, recommendations and internal/ external trends.
Work with claims and underwriting teams to understand where fraud exposure exists and where recovery opportunity is available.
Collaborate on new growth setups (e.g. TPA/ MGAs), new product designs and customer initiatives through assessing the impact on recovery and inherent fraud risk and ensuring the right operating model is in place.
Assess the performance of the international fraud and recovery vendor panel, ensuring vendor performance is of the highest quality, delivering value with appropriate expense discipline.
Manage the implementation and monitor the effectiveness of the international fraud and recovery training and awareness campaigns for Claims and Underwriting.
Plan, manage and evaluate work of staff; make decisions regarding pay, performance management, development, employment and staffing requirements.
Ensure compliance with all country laws and regulations regarding fraud and recovery best practices, guidelines, reporting and submissions and data privacy requirements.
Function as the AIG liaison and point of contact for Global Fraud Industry associations and regional/country regulators, law enforcement etc. where required.
Manage expenses within established and approved budget guidelines.

Extensive knowledge of claims, insurance markets, fraud and recovery legislation and handling processes, along with other relevant data/ compliance legislation.
Connectivity with relevant fraud and recovery industry associations, with demonstrable credibility.
Ability to leverage technology and analytics to achieve goals including experience in the implementation of AI and Machine learning to assess trends and identify opportunities to drive improved results.
Able to lead complex change initiatives with an ability to work to tight timelines when necessary.
Experience and confidence to lead a large, diverse team and engage a geographically dispersed group of stakeholders.
Comfortable working across differing time zones to support engagement of regional fraud and recovery teams and to actively contribute to the global leadership team.
Able to take ownership of their area of responsibility and work with others to win together in both virtual and in person environments, helping to develop and nurture a high-performance culture.
Excellent communication skills with a strong collaborative mindset to influence stakeholders internally within Fraud and Recovery and other key stakeholders (International/Regional/ LOB claims stakeholders, Underwriters, Actuaries, Risk Compliance, Legal, Vendors, Customers etc).

Join us as a Lead Analyst, Legal Entity Capital Modelling and Production, to take your career to the next level with a global market leader.
How you will create an impact
Reporting to the Head of Legal Entity Capital Modeling and Production, you will support the production processes across Global Risk and the Capital Modeling and Analytics team including the Group Capital Model, two Solvency II approved Internal Models for both UK and Europe, other local legal entity models and support to Talbot models as appropriate.
The Legal Entity capital models for UK and Europe are used in assessment of Capital Adequacy, Portfolio Management, Risk Management, Asset Management and Reinsurance Management and have approval under Solvency II from their respective regulators. In addition, the team maintains other legal entity capital models, currently Canada and Bermuda models, which support local legal entity risk management and Own Risk and Solvency reporting (ORSA) requirements.
Production processes consist of supporting regular updates of all models, including collection of inputs, quality assurance, implementing controls and validation tests, production of results, analysis of change and assisting with presentations. Furthermore, production includes review and optimization of processes via the creation of new tools and automation as required.
Some of the key responsibilities include:
Produce and present model output and changes for key projects to business stakeholders.
Support business partners with use requirements: Risk Officers with updates to Risk Reporting, Risk Appetite monitoring, Stress Testing, ORSA
Capital Management for Overall Capital Assessments
Reinsurance Officers for Reinsurance Adequacy
Market Risk Officers for analytics on the Investment Portfolio
Support the production of quarterly Internal Model baselines for Group, UK, Europe, Canada and Bermuda legal entities for presentation committees or regulators as appropriate.
Support initiatives to integrate production processes across AIG’s Capital Models (including Group and Talbot where appropriate) to achieve a unified annual run calendar, and common working practices and quality assurance leading to greater resilience.
Keep both the Internal Model and Standard Formula up to date with Regulatory Changes, changes in the company’s risk profile and changes in external environment.
Update logs, reports, testing and documentation such as the Technical Issues log, Expert Judgement Log, Sensitivity Testing Report and Model documentation.
What you'll need to succeed
MSc in a quantitative field, Qualified Actuary or equivalent
5+ years of experience in capital modeling for a General Insurance company
Experience in actuarial pricing or reserving is beneficial.
Experience in the regulation of Solvency II in relation to Internal Models and good background knowledge of other related regulatory regimes.
Able to work with senior business partners and Risk Officers, and present model outputs to internal and external stakeholders
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a global team environment
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Strong quality control and review skills both qualitative and quantitative
Understanding of risk management tools and risk quantification techniques for all risk areas
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with capital modeling packages, in particular Igloo, and programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab and VBA would be beneficial

Apply
This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Spotify, Playstation, Ebay, and Tide - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Why you should join the Adyen Account Management team
At Adyen, the Account Management team is critical to the growth and success of our business, as well as expanding the Adyen brand across the globe. Being part of our Account Management team, you’ll manage relationships with innovative international merchants, covering multiple industries and channels. You’ll have the opportunity to work on cross-functional initiatives and projects in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment with high autonomy. You’ll become an expert in the global payments landscape and level up your skills through our AM Academy.
We are looking for a proactive and adaptable Account Manager to join our team in London. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a hands-on mentality; someone who is eager to help the world’s biggest brands grow while changing an industry. You are excited to work with a global, multicultural team in a collaborative manner and help your team succeed. Your focus will be on delivering an outstanding customer experience, finding new opportunities, and driving mutual success for Adyen and our customers.
Enterprise Account Manager, Platforms and Financial Services
Adyen’s value goes beyond Ecommerce and In-Person payments with a broad offering of embedded payments and financial services like issuing, bank accounts and capital; facilitated by Adyen’s global Banking licenses.
As a Platforms Account Manager in London you will educate and lead our merchants through continuous growth enabled by the Adyen for Platforms solution. The focus will be on global SaaS platforms and E-Commerce marketplaces that provide a range of services to SMBs. By leveraging both Adyen’s embedded payments solution and financial services offerings, your role will be to activate new revenue streams for these platforms and build long-lasting partnerships.
The strong partnership focus within Account Management drives innovation, scalability and expansion, enabling our platform partners to build a profitable payments layer into their solutions. You will build long-lasting relationships with the platform partners across multiple departments, acting as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders within the Leadership, Sales, Onboarding, Risk, Finance and Product Teams.
Sounds exciting? Keep reading!
What You’ll Do:
Power the growth of your customer’s platform in multiple channels and regions, by proactively advising on Adyen’s products and services as well as the international payments landscape
Be the strategic payments and financial services adviser for all of your customer’s different departments
Enable Platforms for scalability through products and marketing that fit their strategy and roadmaps
Oversee and Optimise the integration of the platform into various Adyen for Platforms product offerings
Work closely with the other Adyen offices around the globe, with Technical and Sales teams to realize individual and thought-through integrations for platforms based on their needs
Understand the evolving needs of the customer and the market and serve as a feedback loop for Adyen’s product team to help identify improvements and developments for continued innovation
Who You Are:
You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in a client-facing or product management role, ideally B2B dealing with complex enterprise software
Commercial experience working within payments, financial services, marketplaces, or SaaS platforms
A born networker with high energy, self-starter with a proven commercial and organizational strength, entrepreneurial track record and strong negotiation skills
A strategic thinker with excellent project management skills and the ability to lead and manage time-sensitive, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment with little supervision
A natural communicator and team player, comfortable driving technical and commercial discussions
A problem solver, naturally curious and comfortable navigating ambiguity to find solutions for technical, commercial, and operational challenges.
A cross functional project manager of commercial, operational, and technical projects
Have a hands-on mentality being able to set the path for your platform merchants and their onboarding, payment, payout and reporting setup, at the same time make smart decisions on prioritization and delegation while looking at short- and long term planning
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
This role is based out of our London office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

Strong negotiation, relationship management, and commercial agreement structuring skills.
Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial.
International experience—working in multiple markets or managing cross-border relationships.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills—able to connect with stakeholders at all levels and communicate project expectations and progress effectively.
Thrive under pressure—work well in a high-velocity environment with aggressive timelines, constant change, and dynamic priorities.
Creative problem-solving skills and innate curiosity—we’re trying to grow Airwallex exponentially by exploring new business constructs, not just replicating the old models employed by industry incumbents

Experience at a global, high-growth fintech or pre-IPO startup.
Experience building financial partnerships in a new geography.
Experience with merchant acquiring and/or card portfolio management and optimizing pricing, interchange, and product profitability.
Recognized as an industry thought leader; experience representing your company at industry events.
